# Texas Logistic & Fulfillment Takes Over Former Amazon Facility in Sugar Land

Texas Logistic & Fulfillment is taking over a former Amazon warehouse in Sugar Land, Texas, converting the 300,000-square-foot site into a climate-controlled 3PL hub. The expansion includes nearly 100,000 square feet of bonded space for international logistics flexibility and introduces an inclusive employment initiative in partnership with Texas HHSC. The company continues to grow rapidly, now supporting logistics for major retailers like Best Buy and CVS Health.

###### William Carlin

editor@racklify.com

30 Jun 2025 6:16 PM

Texas Logistic & Fulfillment is expanding into a 300,000 sq. ft. former Amazon warehouse in Sugar Land, Texas.

The facility includes bonded space and will focus on HVAC-enabled logistics for sensitive goods like lithium batteries.

G10 Fulfillment to Celebrate Grand Opening of New Kenosha Distribution Facility with Ribbon-Cutting Ceremony

# G10 Fulfillment to Celebrate Grand Opening of New Kenosha Distribution Facility with Ribbon-Cutting Ceremony

 Geneva10 

Sep 01, 2026, 08:34 ET

Mayor and Kenosha County Executive to join company and community leaders in marking the milestone expansion

KENOSHA, Wis., Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- G10 Fulfillment, a North American third-party logistics and fulfillment provider, will hold a ribbon-cutting ceremony celebrating the grand opening of its new distribution facility in Kenosha, Wisconsin, on Thursday, September 10, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. at 12345 38th Street.

The new 315,000-square-foot facility replaces G10's former Twin Lakes location and more than doubles the company's Midwest warehouse capacity. Spartan Logistics Expands Southeast Presence with New Darlington, SC Facility

August 17, 2026 - Spartan Logistics, a leading third-party logistics provider and warehousing company, is expanding its operational footprint in the Southeast with a 204,000-square-foot, rail-served facility in Darlington, South Carolina.

Spartan Logistics will operate the facility at 310 B Avenue in Darlington on behalf of a long-standing customer, strengthening the relationship and expanding the company's reliable warehousing and supply chain solutions in the region.

The strategically located facility provides access to both rail and major highway networks, including I-20 and I-95, offering efficient connectivity to markets throughout South Carolina and the Southeast. The location will support the customers’ ongoing distribution and supply chain needs while expanding Spartan's operational presence in the region.
